#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to the end of the quarterly report."""
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.document import Document

doc = Document("unpacked")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]

# Locate the final content paragraph (RISK FACTORS body) - the section will
# be inserted after it, before <w:sectPr/>.
last_para = editor.get_node(tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include")

# Reuse the document's formatting for all new paragraphs
RPR = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" '
       'w:cs="Helvetica Light"/><w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')

def p(text):
    return f'<w:p><w:pPr/><w:r>{RPR}<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'

new_section = (
    p("RECOMMENDATIONS") +
    p("") +
    p("Based on Q4 2024 performance, management recommends the following actions for Q1 2025:") +
    p("• Expand cloud services capacity to sustain the 22.8% YoY growth and capture additional enterprise demand.") +
    p("• Increase investment in customer acquisition and retention programs to build on improved marketing efficiency.") +
    p("• Maintain research and development spending at or above 12% of revenue to support new product launches.") +
    p("• Strengthen currency hedging and diversify suppliers to mitigate the risks outlined above.") +
    p("")
)

editor.insert_after(last_para, new_section)
doc.save()
print("RECOMMENDATIONS section added successfully.")
